top_choice_rationale: Buchwald and Hartwig solved a distinct chemical problem from the 2010 cross-coupling prize: C-N coupling needed amido-palladium formation and difficult C-N reductive elimination without beta-hydride elimination, which was achieved through successive ligand classes. Thirty years of routine use in medicinal chemistry, process routes and materials show full maturity, and the credit is a clean, independent two-name allocation.
